summary: Level kerb at the foot of York Street, cars park here, flats 16-20 m away.
reasons: Rest of the stretch is steep

best_section.where: East kerb at the bottom of the hill, beside the grey-roofed townhouses near the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Townhouses and apartments close on the east; homes and flats across the road. Nearest mapped dwellings 16-20 m near the bottom.
drivers.access_and_room: Parking lane on the east kerb is lined with parked cars; a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Residential street near a rail line and junction; moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep overall: mean 12.4%, max 20.6%; only the bottom 70-87 m is near level
Signs: No Parking Specified Times; check times on site
Rail noise from the corridor to the north-west
sun_shade: Mixed: trees shade the east verge in the afternoon, kerb open to morning sun.
